description: 3W Dataset 2.0.0: a realistic and public dataset with rare undesirable real events in oil wells is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Ricardo Emanuel Vaz Vargas et al. In the oil industry, undesirable events in oil wells can cause economic losses, environmental accidents, and human casualties. In 2019, recognizing the importance and the lack of public datasets related to undesirable events in oil wells, Petrobras developed and publicly released the first version of the 3W Dataset, which is essentially a set of Multivariate Time Series labeled by experts. Coverage: not stated; published in 2026. Formats: Parquet. The data are held in arXiv and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
